title: Noah — The Man Who Built the Ark
objective: Students will learn about Noah and how he obeyed God by building the Ark.
content: Noah was a good man who loved God. God told Noah to build a very big boat called an Ark. Noah listened and obeyed!
God told Noah to bring two of every animal onto the Ark. Noah brought big animals and little animals, birds and bugs. Then God sent rain for 40 days and 40 nights!
After the flood, God put a rainbow in the sky. The rainbow was God's promise that He would never flood the whole earth again. When you see a rainbow, remember God keeps His promises!
activity: Color a picture of Noah's Ark with animals. Draw a rainbow in the sky above the Ark.
discussion: What did God tell Noah to build?
What animals went on the Ark?
